reasons.message: The URL contains user information before the hostname.
The URL contains at least two account-related terms.
The port differs from the scheme's default.

limitations: Low risk is not proof of safety. URL strings alone cannot establish a site's intent.
Rule observations explain the heuristic branch, not the model's prediction.
Scores are not calibrated probabilities. No DNS, page, TLS, or reputation checks run.
Model artifact unavailable; this result uses rules only.
